def parse_demos(text):
    pairs=[]
    pat=re.compile(r'Demo pair (\d+) input \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n(.*?)\nDemo pair \1 output \(\d+x\d+\):\n(.*?)(?=\n\nSame instance\.|\nWrong attempts used:)',re.S)
    for m in pat.finditer(text):
        n=int(m.group(2)); ni=[[int(z) for z in line.split()] for line in m.group(4).splitlines() if line.strip()]
        no=[[int(z) for z in line.split()] for line in m.group(5).splitlines() if line.strip()]
        pairs.append((ni,no))
    return pairs
all_demos=[]
for t in user_texts:
    all_demos.extend(parse_demos(t))
print(len(all_demos),[(len(a),len(b),len(b[0])) for a,b in all_demos])
